messages:
maria: Quick post-RFC check: we still lack a clear owner table for cross-mode surfaces (secrets, rollouts, tracing). can we lock that down here?
aj: yes. propose we keep it minimal: capability -> owner(control|runtime|hybrid) -> failure-mode.
sam: important: Dedicated customers expect local control for keys. default model: Hosted = control unwraps (audited), Dedicated = optional customer-kms plugin, Private = runtime-only (fail-closed).
neha: rollout behavior: control-plane publishes signed rollout blobs with TTL. runtime must verify sig to apply when offline. add capability flag OFFLINE_POLICY.
infra-bot: note: telemetry schema update required, creating ticket INF-4600.
maria: RPC sketch for contract: Handshake() -> {version, capabilities}, CheckCapacity(), DispatchRequest(), ReportUsage(). keep it tiny so older runtimes can interop.
aj: compatibility rule: missing capability -> treat as 'limited' not error. migration plan: advertise-only -> soft-enforce -> strict.
sam: fallback ordering: same-host variant -> region -> hosted fallback. document SLA impacts.
maria: Action items: aj drafts RPC proto, neha drafts rollout blob shape, sam writes KMS plugin fallback examples. I'll fold into RFC. Closing once PRs posted. :white_check_mark:
